569-2226-2397.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
569-2226-2397.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Panharmonicon.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Mist Raven by paying its mana cost.
When Mist Raven enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

997-7084-8293.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Cleveland Booker triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2074-3899-6972.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Vorapede
When Vorapede dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Vorapede
When Vorapede dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Spawning Pit abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
2074-3899-6972.notes: If Vorapede starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

1669-5233-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Boros Garrison.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Boros Garrison from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boros Garrison enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Thaumatog ability
Repeat.

654-1479-5700-5701-7893.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
654-1479-5700-5701-7893.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1477-2073-7876-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Consulate Dreadnought from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Consulate Dreadnought enters, Kolodin triggers, causing Consulate Dreadnought to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Consulate Dreadnought.
When Consulate Dreadnought dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

2292-2626-3661-4986.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
Activate Salvager of Ruin by sacrificing it, returning Shield Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Salvager of Ruin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

567-3375-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Immortal Sun.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Soul's Attendant trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Soul's Attendant trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
567-3375-4399-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

2103-6568-7722.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Y'shtola Rhul.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Capture of Jingzhou from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

1518-3923-4050-7639.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 2.
1518-3923-4050-7639.description:
Activate Will Kenrith's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to draw two cards and causing instant, sorcery and planeswalker spells you cast to cost {2} less to cast until your next turn.
Cast Mystic Speculation by paying {U} due to Will Kenrith.
Namor triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve Mystic Speculation.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Merfolk, adding {U}.
Repeat from step 2.

1768-2292--5.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Juniper Order Ranger triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and Juniper Order Ranger.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat

2724-3080-4608-7068.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four enchantments.
2724-3080-4608-7068.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters the battlefield, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
Activate Baboon Spirit by paying {3}{U}, exiling Wormfang Manta
At the beginning of your end step, Baboon Spirit triggers, returning Wormfang Manta from exile to the battlefield.
Exchange of Words leaves and enters the battlefield, triggering the second ability it gained from Wormfang Manta's textbox as well as its own ability.
Resolve the first Exchange of Words trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the second Exchange of Words trigger, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
Repeat from step 3 during each turn.

147-2034-6814.description:
Cast Abnormal Endurance by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Abnormal Endurance, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Abnormal Endurance.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1778-2173-2981-5220.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Memnite
When Memnite dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Memnite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Cast Memnite from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

2757-3525-6858.description:
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Oreskos Sun Guide, untapping the Island.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Oreskos Sun Guide.
Oreskos Sun Guide triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

2034-4013-4908-5004-6643.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cathodion, adding {C}{C}.
When Cathodion dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Edgar.
Cast Cathodion from your graveyard by paying {2}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Oracle of Mul Daya

280-5449-5702-6763.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
280-5449-5702-6763.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm. When it enters untapped due to Horizon Explorer, Golgari Rot Farm and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Oracle of Mul Daya.
Because of the additional Oracle of Mul Daya token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

1358-1812-2034-2073--90.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning the mana value 1 artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Sydri's first ability by paying {U}, causing the artifact to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the artifact, adding {C}{C}.
When the artifact dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Activate Prismite by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Repeat.

586-5258-5618-5686-6580.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-4885-6438.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4885-6438.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Elsha, triggering Breath of Fury and Elsha.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

803-1429-3967-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
803-1429-3967-5402.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

618-2511-4142.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Hostage Taker.
When the Hostage Taker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the Hostage Taker token.
When the Hostage Taker token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

372-4863-5895.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Splash Portal exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Revolutionist exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Splash Portal.
372-4863-5895.description:
Cast Splash Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Revolutionist and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Revolutionist trigger.
Resolve the Revolutionist trigger, returning Splash Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Splash Portal.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Revolutionist and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

791-3693-4522-5934.notablePrerequisites:
Quest for Pure Flame has at least four quest counters on it.
There are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
You have a way to give Walking Ballista lifelink.
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or your life total is at least 4.
791-3693-4522-5934.description:
Give Walking Ballista lifelink, if needed.
If Walking Ballista has less than two +1/+1 counters on it, activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 4 damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

586-4790-5921.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Priest of Gix that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
When the Priest of Gix token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding six {B}.
Repeat.

1621-4890.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Dack's Duplicate.
1621-4890.description:
Cast Dack's Duplicate by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel
When Dack's Duplicate enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Dack's Duplicate. Choose to have Dack's Duplicate enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.

1386-1517-2845-3556.notablePrerequisites: The Mirari Conjecture has exactly two lore counters on it.
1386-1517-2845-3556.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The Mirari Conjecture triggers, putting a lore counter on it, and then causing you to copy any instant or sorcery spell you cast this turn and sacrifice The Mirari Conjecture.
Cast Flicker by paying {1}{W}, targeting Meldweb Curator.
The Mirari Conjecture triggers, copying Flicker targeting Quintorius Kand.
Resolve the copy of Flicker, blinking Quintorius Kand.
Resolve the original Flicker, blinking Meldweb Curator.
When Meldweb Curator enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting Flicker on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Quintorius Kand's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, causing you to exile Flicker from the top of your library and cast it without paying its mana cost, targeting Meldweb Curator.
Quintorius Kand and The Mirari Conjecture trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius Kand trigger, dealing 2 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the The Mirari Conjecture trigger, copying Flicker targeting Quintorius Kand.
Repeat from step 4.

1182-4316-5220.description:
Cast Stonecoil Serpent from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Stonecoil Serpent enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Stonecoil Serpent on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

1495-1887-2744-3828.notablePrerequisites:
Druid's Call attached to Triskelion.
Triskelion has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
1495-1887-2744-3828.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Druid's Call triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Repeat.
During the next player's turn, you may remove all of the +1/+1 counters from Triskelion to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

2499-3657-4939.description:
Activate Kogla by paying {1}{G}, returning Burning-Tree Emissary to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Burning-Tree Emissary by paying {R/G}{R/G}.
When Burning-Tree Emissary enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding {R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

2505-4499-4893-5313.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {1}, blinking Thragtusk.
Thragtusk enters and leaves the battlefield, triggering its abilities.
Resolve the Thragtusk enters-the-battlefield trigger, causing you to gain five life.
Resolve the Thragtusk leaves-the-battlefield trigger, creating a 3/3 Beast creature token.
Activate Treasonous Ogre by paying three life, adding {R}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Jugan Defends the Temple // Remnant of the Rising Star

1096-1747-2034.notablePrerequisites:
Woodfall Primus does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
A player controls an indestructible noncreature permanent.
1096-1747-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Woodfall Primus, adding {C}{C}.
Woodfall Primus dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Woodfall Primus enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Remnant of the Rising Star.
Resolve the Woodfall Primus trigger, failing to destroy an indestructible noncreature permanent.
Resolve the Remnant of the Rising Star trigger, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on Woodfall Primus.
Repeat.

1517-2103-3715.description:
Play The Mirari Conjecture and Capture of Jingzhou, then go to the next turn.
Use Conjecture's 2nd activation to add Capture of Jingzhou back to hand, then play Power Conduit.
Play Capture of Jingzhou.
Go to the next turn.
Activate Power Conduit to remove a saga counter from Conjecture, then add back Capture of Jingzhou when Conjecture's 2nd activation triggers again.

1953-2105-4615.description:
Cast Quasiduplicate by paying {1}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Brudiclad triggers, creating a 2/1 Phyrexian Myr creature token, then choosing to have all tokens you control become copies of the Combat Celebrant token.
Declare one of the Combat Celebrant copy as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks.
The Combat Celebrant copy triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.
